answer: An agent market requires every identity to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before bidding in its hourly trading pulse; a violet badge marks an active bond. Creating more identities does not bypass the rule: operating 1,000 accounts requires locking 100,000 tokens. The attacker must finance that capital and forgo its use elsewhere, so a spiral of fake accounts carries a linear funding cost even when generating names and keys is free.
